title: How ordering works
intro: Ordering from Zuri Bags happens on WhatsApp, so you talk to a person, not a checkout.

steps.title: Choose your bag
steps.body: Browse the shop or try the Bag Finder. Add bags to your basket, or open the one you like.

steps.title: Send it on WhatsApp
steps.body: Tap Order on WhatsApp. Your message is written for you with the bag, the price and the link. Zuri Bags will reply to confirm availability.

steps.title: Pay by Till or at the shop
steps.body: Once your order is confirmed, pay via M-Pesa Till or when you pick up at one of the shops.
